versions.subject: Merge PR #5479 from @swachchhanda000 - Webdav CVE-2025-33053 RCE vulnerability
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage:
        - 'C:\Program Files\internet explorer\iediagcmd.exe'
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\CustomShellHost.exe'
selection_child_current_dir:
    - CurrentDirectory|startswith: '\\\\'
    - CurrentDirectory|contains: '\DavWWWRoot\'
    - Image|contains: '\DavWWWRoot\'
    - Image|startswith: '\\\\'
selection_child_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\route.exe'
        - '\netsh.exe'
        - '\makecab.exe'
        - '\dxdiag.exe'
        - '\ipconfig.exe'
        - '\explorer.exe'
filter_main_system:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("C:\\Program Files\\internet explorer\\iediagcmd.exe", "C:\\Windows\\System32\\CustomShellHost.exe") CurrentDirectory="\\\\*" OR CurrentDirectory="*\\DavWWWRoot\\*" OR Image="*\\DavWWWRoot\\*" OR Image="\\\\*" Image IN ("*\\route.exe", "*\\netsh.exe", "*\\makecab.exe", "*\\dxdiag.exe", "*\\ipconfig.exe", "*\\explorer.exe") NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\System32\\*", "C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\*"))
